description: Screens that look like work or a request but are not: quoted status rows, prose questions, the transcript viewer. Each step repaints the screen.
provenance: Authored, not recorded. The quoted-status-row and prose-question screens are the cases Orca's tests (codex-quiet-ready-screen.test.ts) pin; the transcript viewer text is from herdr's codex manifest.
